units.source_text: 每天到出名的温泉洗澡可以暖暖身子，而且为了赴宴往返旧温泉和新温泉之间还得走一里地，

en.t: Bathing every day in the famous hot spring kept her body warm, and going back and forth between the old and new hot springs for banquets meant walking a full ri,

units.source_text: 在山沟里又很少熬夜，所以身体健壮，不过还是长着一副艺妓常见的窄骨盆，

en.t: and since she rarely stayed up late in that mountain valley, she was sturdy and healthy, though she still had the narrow pelvis often seen in geisha,
her frame narrow from side to side and thick from front to back.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，她之所以能把岛村从老远吸引到这儿来，乃是因为她身上蕴藏着令人深深同情的东西。

en.t: Even so, what drew Shimamura all this way to her was that she held within herself something that stirred a deep pity.
